description_en: Retrieves the rule information of a hybrid cloud cluster
description_zh: 获取混合云集群规则信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-cluster-rule --instance-id waf-cn-uqm33n00002 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudClusterRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
[Deprecated] The rule type. Valid values:
pullin: cluster traffic redirection
parameters.help_zh:
【废弃】规则类型。取值范围如下：
pullin：集群引流
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

RuleConfig.description_en:
The traffic redirection rule configuration:

check_mode: the mode selection. Valid values:
all: full traffic redirection
part: partial traffic redirection
type: the rule matching type. Valid values:
exact: exact match
regex: regular expression
substance: the rule value
RuleConfig.description_zh:
引流规则配置：

check_mode 模式选择 取值：
all：全量引流
part：指定部分引流
type：规则匹配类型取值：
exact：精准
regex：正则
substance：规则值

RuleStatus.description_en:
The rule status. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
RuleStatus.description_zh:
规则状态，取值范围如下：

on：开启。

off：关闭

RuleType.description_en:
The rule type. Valid values:

pullin: traffic redirection rule
RuleType.description_zh:
规则类型：

pullin：引流规则
